# ScienceBench Task 47

## Overview

- Domain: Geographical Information Science
- Subtask Categories: Geospatial Analysis, Map Visualization
- Source: geopandas/geopandas
- Output Type: Image

## Task

Calculate road distance for the habitat polygons and map the results. Export the visualization as a PNG file.

## Dataset

[START Dataset Preview: MountainLionNew]
|-- Mountain_Lion_Habitat.geojson
|-- road.geojson
|-- distance_to_roads.tif
[END Dataset Preview]

## Submission Format

Save the output PNG file.

## Evaluation

The grader compares the submitted image against the gold visualization using LLM as judge (threshold 60/100).
